pages.title: Under the blue flag · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a bright morning in the old part of Washington. Cris walks to a big white statue. A small group of tourists stands there. Many of them hold maps and cameras. A man named Ned holds a blue flag. He greets everyone with a loud voice.
“Hello, everyone! Are you here for the history walk?” says Ned. “Yes! When does it start?” says Cris. “It starts in ten minutes, at ten o’clock.” says Ned.

pages.title: Under the blue flag · 3/3
paragraphs: “Do we need water or a hat?” says Cris. “Yes, bring water and a hat. It is sunny today.” says Ned. At ten, Ned lifts the flag and starts to walk. The group follows him down a wide street. At the first stop, he shows an old building. Cris takes notes and many photos. After two hours, they return to the statue. History feels alive when you walk through it.
